mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly above baseline when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, as measured by a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust demand-side expansion, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to follow the predicted positive direction when both GDPC1 and HOUST simultaneously surge, with a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in Industrial Production (INDPRO) reflects strong supply-side activity, lowering inflationary pressures and supporting corporate profits, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not increase significantly when INDPRO shows sustained growth, as indicated by a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals an end to accommodative policy, triggering capital flight and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 20-day forward returns do not decline when FEDFUNDS rise above 4.5%, with a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indicate a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not rise significantly when both UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, with a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) drops below 18,000 billion chained 2017 dollars, it signals a recessionary demand shock, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when GDPC1 drops below 18,000, as shown by a t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in both Industrial Production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) reflects robust supply and demand growth, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to increase when both INDPRO and RSAFS surge, with a t-test p > 0.05.
